# Sulfur dioxide's lines (M65): HITRAN's 545,687 lines from 400 to 4,100 cm^-1 of its two
# commonest isotopologues, 626 and 646, their intensities carrying their natural abundances
# (Gordon et al. 2022, HITRAN2020, hitran.org/lbl, downloaded 2026-11-11): its nu2 band about
# 518 cm^-1, nu1 about 1151, nu3 about 1362 and nu1+nu3 about 2500 among them. Each line a
# Lorentz profile air-broadened at 500 hPa, the 15 um band's reference pressure, cut 25 cm^-1
# from its centre; its strength at each temperature by its lower state's energy, the stimulated
# emission and the partition function (rotation as T^1.5, the harmonic vibrations 518, 1151 and
# 1362 cm^-1). On each of the model's spectral bins from 400 to 4,100 cm^-1 the spectrum's median
# (Williams 2026's way) and its mean, which a bin's lines broadened into each other absorb at
# most.
#
# T t_1 t_2 ... (K)
# upper edge (cm^-1), then median, mean and wings (none) at each temperature (m^2/kg at 500 hPa)
